text: The key difference between ordinary HoTT and simplicial type theory is:
choices: simplicial TT has directed morphisms (hom types) alongside undirected paths (identity types)
simplicial TT uses a different interval
explanation: HoTT has only symmetric paths (a=b). Simplicial TT adds directed morphisms hom_A(a,b) that need not be invertible, enabling synthetic (∞,1)-category theory.
